explanation: After normalizing the failure (singleton norms summing to $3$, total below $3q$, pair-gap sum below $2/(0.448p)$; `scaled_failure`), the largest coordinate of each pair sum is within $\log 3/p$ of its norm (`exists_signed_coord`). Two pairs sharing a vector cannot share their dominant coordinate (`signed_conflict`), so after a permutation and signs (`orient`) pair $(j,k)$ is dominant at coordinate $i$. A second pass with the half-size tail bound (`dominant_half`) tightens the slack to $10^{-5}$, and linear arithmetic gives the coarse box (`oriented_core`).
